Current 2006 Aston Martin V8 Vantage 4.3 manual at £33,980 / 51,600 miles from Tier One Automotive, Kings Langley. Advert is live with seller contact and valid MOT; sampled seller photos show no unavailable overlay and the cabin shows a manual shifter. Nine previous owners and Bamford Rose exhaust/catalyst/flywheel/twin-plate-clutch modifications weaken the exceptional/original-example case; hold for editorial and provenance review.

Current 2007 Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster at £33,400 / 60,500 miles, advertised manual by a private seller in Revesby with active contact and valid MOT. It has a GMR supercharger conversion advertised at 573 bhp and other modifications; exterior photos show no unavailable overlay, but the manual gear-selector photo was not verified in this run. Hold unverified/editorial review; do not publish.

Current 2008 Aston Martin V8 Vantage N400 Roadster at £35,991 / 46,345 miles from ASM Automotive, Redditch, with live reservation controls. Seller identifies N400 car #179 and full main-dealer history. Sampled current photos show no unavailable overlay, but the manual gear-selector photo was not verified strongly enough in this run; keep pending.

Fully verified and published: 2008 Aston Martin V8 Vantage N400 Roadster, £39,500, 29,000 miles, six-speed manual, private seller in Oxted, Surrey. Live advert has current seller contact; five seller vehicle photos were inspected with no unavailable overlay, the manual shifter is clearly visible and N400 Nürburgring detailing is visible. Seller states ownership since 2018, full service history, August 2026 service and MOT to June 2027 with no advisories.
